# Domain & UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Universal Cycle Weight Tracking & Momentum Engine

**Purpose**: Validate mathematical, UX, accessibility, and persistence requirement quality across `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `data-model.md`, and `contracts/`.
**Created**: 2026-11-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` workflow based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Mathematical & Domain Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact weekly percentage corridors defined for all three `WeightSubcycleType` options (`WEIGHT_LOSS`, `RECOMPOSITION`, `WEIGHT_GAIN`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Is the linear interpolation formula between consecutive `REAL` weigh-ins explicitly specified for arbitrary gap lengths $\Delta t > 1$? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are the reactive recalculation rules defined for inserting, editing, and deleting `REAL` weigh-ins and promoting `THEORETICAL` weigh-ins? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK004 Are cumulative cold-start window rules ($1 \le K < N$) and pre-cycle historical lookback rules unambiguously specified for `7D`, `14D`, `21D`, and `28D` horizons? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK005 Is the `3:4:2:1` weighting formula for the Weekly Body Weight composite ($\text{BW}_{\text{weekly}}$) explicitly defined with divisor `10`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK006 Are the weekly percentage Momentum formula, 8-day calibration warm-up gate, and diagnostic classification zones (`< -1.50%`, `[-1.50%, -0.50%)`, `[-0.50%, +0.25%]`, `(+0.25%, +1.50%]`, `> +1.50%`) fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK007 Is the dynamic finish weight compounding formula $\text{BW}_{\text{weekly}} \times (1 + r)^{W_{\text{left}}}$ specified with behavior for final-week ($< 1.0\text{w}$), completed cycle ($W_{\text{left}} = 0$), and open-ended cycle states? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-010, §Edge Cases]

## UI, Accessibility & Persistence Consistency

- [x] CHK008 Are all header lines, primary composite row (`✦ Weekly Body Weight`), and 4 horizon rows (`7D`, `14D`, `21D`, `28D`) of `SPEC-WEIGHT-CARD-01` specified with exact formatting and 3-zone Corridor Range Gauge semantics? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Contract §1]
- [x] CHK009 Are the interactive requirements and live finish-weight previews for `SPEC-WEIGHT-SUBTYPE-SHEET-01` (`Select Subcycle Type` bottom sheet) completely defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Contract §2]
- [x] CHK010 Are universal cycle support requirements specified across both `ProgressScreen` and `CyclesScreen` (`STRENGTH_WEIGHTLIFTING` and `FAT_LOSS_BODYBUILDING`)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK011 Are accessibility requirements (`48dp` touch target, `1.3x` font scaling, `< 360dp` responsive wrapping, TalkBack `contentDescription`) and unit localization (`kg` and `lbs`) documented? [Non-Functional, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK012 Are backward-compatible Room v10 persistence (`[subcycle=...]` metadata in `Cycle.goal`) and Coaching MCP Server telemetry contracts specified without conflicts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Research §Decision 1]
